cues.text:
The sky is still unbroken
The road is dark and long

I have prayed into the silence
And waited for the dawn

But somewhere in the darkness
Morning had begun

Before I ever saw the light
You were there; Father, Spirit, Son.

I don’t need the horizon
To tell me You are near

I don’t need the answer
To know that You are here

You were there before the morning
Before the light ever broke through

Before I saw the answer
I was held by You

You were there before the morning
Faithful through the night

I will sing before I see it
I will trust You for the light
If I rise on the wings of the dawn,

If I settle by the farthest sea,
Even there, Your hand guides me,
Holding me for eternity.
The shadows lose their edges

The darkness turns to blue
And looking back I finally see

You carried me straight through
In the midnight of the prison,

Paul and Silas raised a song,
They praised You in the darkness,

And their faith held strong.
You were moving in the silence

You were working while I prayed
The morning did not make You faithful

It only showed the way
I don’t need the horizon

To tell me You are near
I don’t need the answer

To know that You are here
You were there before the morning

Before the light broke through
Before I saw the answer

I was already held by You
You were there before the morning

Faithful through the night
I will sing before I see it
I will trust You for the light

Before the answer
Before the change
Before the sunlight calls my name

You are here
Before I see

Before I know
Before the morning starts to glow

I will sing
I will sing before I see
I will sing before I see
You are here

You are here
Somewhere in the darkness

Morning had begun
You were there before the morning

Before the light broke through
Before I saw the answer

I was already held by You
You were there before the morning

Faithful through the night
I will sing before I see it

I will trust You for the light
You were there

You were there
Before the morning

You were there
You were there

Through the night
I will sing

Before I see
Jesus, You are here with me
Somewhere in the darkness
Morning had begun
